core.evolution: Evolves into Charmeleon starting at level 16; Charmeleon evolves into Charizard at level 36.

habitat: Found in hot mountainous areas and also recorded in the Blueberry Academy Terarium; many are owned by Trainers.
behavior: Shows pack behavior, calling other Charmander when food is found and checking companions’ tail flames.
Sleeps curled up and appears to draw warmth from its tail flame.
social_structure: Can behave in packs and cooperatively watch the tail flames of other Charmander.
activity_cycle: Known to sleep curled up; quiet-night observations note the sound of its tail flame while sleeping.
likes_preferences: Explicitly prefers hot places and hot things.
physical_characteristics: Small bipedal reptilian Pokémon with an orange body, blue eyes, a cream-colored underside and soles, small fangs, and a slender tail.
A flame has burned at the tail tip since birth.
adaptations: Its tail flame reflects vitality and can remain lit when slightly wet if the Pokémon is healthy.
The tail flame provides warmth while it sleeps.
communication: Calls other Charmander when it finds food.
Tail-flame behavior communicates condition and mood: bright when strong, weak when exhausted, wavering when happy, and blazing when enraged.
reproduction_mating: Game breeding data places it in the Monster and Dragon Egg Groups with a hatch time of 20 cycles.
parenting_young: Newborn Charmander already have flaming tails; young individuals may accidentally burn themselves while unfamiliar with fire.
lifespan_life_cycle: The tail flame burns from birth.
It evolves into Charmeleon at level 16 and later into Charizard at level 36.
